chapter: Cage on work songs, church and social life
title: Old-time fiddle tunes
summary: They talk about tunes such as Arkansas Traveler and Leather Britches, which Cage knows.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Did you ever know an old, old song, I think maybe it was a fiddle piece called down in Shinbone Alley? I know an Arkansas traveler. Oh you know an Arkansas traveler? I thought old time. Yeah. I like that one. I used to try to play that. There's a lot of numbers I like. I like
songs. Leather, leather bridges. See that was all that go there. What's that? Leather britches.

Oh, leather britches. Yeah. And Arkansas traveler. Yellow jacket. Yellow jacket. Yeah. And uh, did you ever know Soldiers Joy? No, I thought. That's more of a hillbilly number I guess. Yeah. That's too new for me. Yeah. Well I know you did a lot of them. I wrote some things down I wanted to, to ask you. What kind of work did your father do?
